praise.page3_scene_description: Pip the robot owl sits on a windowsill at night, holding a glowing newspaper. The front page shows a university building and an office tower, with a big friendly handshake between them.

hidden_elements.fun_fact: This is real news! Carnegie Mellon University and Microsoft started a program called PRAISE.
New engineers in PRAISE take online classes from Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.
Senior engineers at Microsoft coach the new engineers, like a helpful big buddy.

praise.ai_word_definition: A computer program that helps people do a job, like writing code or finding mistakes.
praise.ai_word_illustration_prompt: Warm watercolor of a robot owl learning at a laptop

duet.page3_scene_description: Pip the robot owl sits on a pile of books at night, reading a glowing newspaper. The front page shows a friendly helper robot on a phone screen, with a raised hand to ask a question.

hidden_elements.fun_fact: This is real news! A company called Anthropic made an AI helper named Claude Duet.
Claude Duet has its own apps for Android and iPhone.
This helper checks with you before it does a task for you, just like asking "May I?"

duet.ai_word_definition: An AI that can do tasks for you, not just answer questions.
duet.ai_word_illustration_prompt: Warm watercolor friendly robot raising its hand to ask first

storm.page3_scene_description: Pip the robot owl sits in her nest at night with a glowing newspaper. The front page shows a row of little computer doors with padlocks, and a sneaky raccoon peeking at one lock.

hidden_elements.fun_fact: Passwords work like locks on computer doors. Long, secret passwords are harder to guess.
In the real news, the sneaky ones were hackers who used an AI tool to guess passwords very fast.
Microsoft found the attack and shared the news in October 2026.

storm.ai_word_definition: Someone who breaks into computers they are not allowed to use.
storm.ai_word_illustration_prompt: Warm watercolor robot owl locking a glowing door with key
